ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Using Notepad++ GUP Utility
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Notepad++ updater (gup) from a process other than Notepad++ to download files.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\GUP\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "gup\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-unzipTo\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*"))) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\+\\+\\\.exe$"))
